sn2.29:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Ānandaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn2.29:1.3: Tuyham pi no Ānanda Sāriputto ruccatīti || || 3.
sn2.29:2.1: Kassa hi nāma bhante abālassa aduṭṭhassa amūḷhassa avippallatthacittassa āyasmā Sāriputto na rucceyya ||

sn2.29:4.1: Atha kho Susimo devaputto āyasmato Sāriputtassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne mahatiyā devaputta-patisāya parivuto yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavāntam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 6. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Susimo devaputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn2.29:5.1: Evam etaṃ Bhagavā evam etaṃ Sugata ||
sn2.29:5.2: kassa hi nāma bhante abālassa aduṭṭhassa amūḷhassa avippallatthacittassa āyasmā Sāriputto na rucceyya ||

sn2.29:6.4: kassa hi nāma abālassa aduṭṭhassa amūḷhassa avippallatthacittassa āyasmā Sāriputto na rucceyya ti || || 7.
sn2.29:7.1: Atha kho Susimassa devaputtassa devaputta-parisā āyasmato Sāriputtassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamanā pamuditā pitisomanassajātā uccāvacā vaṇṇanibhā upadaṃseti || 8.
sn2.29:8.1: Seyyathāpi nāma maṇiveḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca ||
sn2.29:8.2: evam evaṃ Susimassa devaputtassa devaputta- parisā āyasmato Sāriputtassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamanā pamoditā pītisomanassajātā uccāvacā vaṇṇanibhā upadaṃseti || 9.
sn2.29:9.1: Seyyathāpi nāma nekkhaṃ jambonadaṃ dakkhakammāraputtena sukusalasampahaṭṭhaṃ paṇḍukambale nikkhittaṃ bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca ||
sn2.29:9.2: evam evaṃ Susimassa devaputtassa devaputtaparisā || pe || upadaṃseti || 10.
sn2.29:10.1: Seyyathāpi nāma rattiyā paccūsamayaṃ osadhitārakā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca ||
sn2.29:10.2: evam evaṃ Susimassa devaputtassa devaputta-parisā āyasmato Sāriputtassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamanā pamuditā pītisomanassajātā uccāvacā vaṇṇanibhā upadaṃseti || 11.
sn2.29:11.1: Seyyathāpi nāma saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabham abbhussukkamāno sabbam ākāsagataṃ tamaṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca ||

sn2.29:12.1: Atha kho Susimo devaputto āyasmantam Sāriputtam ārabbha Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
